user.title: Connect a computer
user.description: Make an API key in the Five More Minutes portal under Plugins: choose the computer and tick the permissions you want Home Assistant to have. The key opens that one computer, from your home network only.

data_description.url: Where Home Assistant can reach it, for example http://192.168.1.10:5072.
data_description.api_key: Starts with fmmk_. It is shown only once, when you make it.

reauth_confirm.title: Enter a new key
reauth_confirm.description: The key for {computer} stopped working: it may have been revoked or have expired. Make a new one in the portal for the same computer and enter it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the address or key
reconfigure.description: Change how Home Assistant reaches {computer}. The key must be for the same computer.

error.invalid_url: That is not a web address. Use something like http://192.168.1.10:5072.
error.invalid_key: That does not look like a Five More Minutes key. It starts with fmmk_ and is 81 characters long.
error.invalid_auth: The key was not accepted. It may be wrong, revoked or expired.
error.network_only: Five More Minutes only answers on your home network. Home Assistant has to be on the same network, using its local address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Five More Minutes. Is it running, and is the address right?
error.missing_state_permission: The key does not have the state:read permission, which this integration needs. Make a new key with it ticked.

abort.already_configured: This computer is already set up. Its address and key have been updated.
abort.wrong_computer: That key is for a different computer, not the one this was set up for.

start_timer.name: Start timer
start_timer.description: Starts time on a computer. Starting during a lock lifts the lock.

device_id.name: Computer
device_id.description: The computer or computers to act on.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long to run. Give this or a time to stop at, not both.

until.name: Until
until.description: The time of day to stop at, in the time zone of the household.

message.name: Message
message.description: A short note shown on the computer, such as why time was given.

extend_timer.name: Add time
extend_timer.description: Adds time to a running timer.

device_id.name: Computer
device_id.description: The computer or computers to act on.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How much to add. Leave empty for the usual five more.

end_time.name: End time now
end_time.description: Ends the timer now, and starts the lock the rules ask for.

device_id.name: Computer
device_id.description: The computer or computers to act on.

cancel_timer.name: Cancel timer
cancel_timer.description: Ends the timer without locking the computer.

device_id.description: The computer or computers to act on.

forbidden.message: The key is not allowed to do that: {reason}

cannot_reach.message: Could not reach Five More Minutes: {reason}

not_a_computer.message: {device} is not a Five More Minutes computer.

key_refused.message: Five More Minutes no longer accepts the key. Make a new one in the portal.
